routing logic · no storage
for each ready input msg:
• route() → output port(s)
• check areNSlotsAvailable(1)
on output buffer (backpressure)
• enqueue into output buffer
no crossbar bw limit:
many msgs/cycle into one
output buffer (bounded only
by its free slots)
